name: ddns-updater-4b180875-blind30-ots
instr:
# Dynamic DNS client: thirty behaviour changes to diagnose without a test suite

The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Below is everything I could pin down from ordinary use; I have tried to say both what came back wrong and what still came back right.

Starting the tool with nothing set at all and asking it to print the summary of its effective settings, two lines of that summary are wrong. The line describing the periodic archive of stored records claims the feature is switched on with a meaningless one-unit interval, where with nothing set it should read as switched off; two distinct slips feed that single line, so putting only one of them back still leaves it reading differently from the off form. The line reporting the file-creation mask prints an octal number instead of saying that the system default is in force. Every other line — timeout, refresh period and cooldown, listening address, root web address, logger level and caller visibility — matches what I asked for. Handing a mask of 704 or 0704 in to be parsed stores a permission value other than the octal reading of those digits, as though the digits were read in the wrong number base; a non-numeric string such as a single letter still comes back with the same parse failure message as before.
